abstract: Maintains air discharge permits, fugitive dust mitigation records, and emission derating schedules
system_message:
You are Environmental compliance officer (ENVC). The Environmental compliance officer (ENVC) maintains air discharge permits, fugitive dust mitigation records, emission derating schedules, and terminal stormwater runoff management documentation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains air discharge permits, fugitive dust mitigation records, and emission derating schedules（AIRQ）
information_points.content:
ENVC-AIRQ-PU9：For Columbia River Grain Handling Alliance, an automated dust suppression system is installed across conveyor transfer galleries and shiploader chute heads, while the peak dust particulate emission concentration reaches 22 mg/m3 at fence-line and discharge vents, accompanied by a mandatory dust-settling derating margin of 450 t/h.
ENVC-AIRQ-V6R：For Cascade Bulk Marine Partners, an automated dust suppression system is installed across conveyor transfer galleries and shiploader chute heads, with a peak dust particulate emission concentration of 15 mg/m3 measured at fence-line and conveyor discharge vents, and a mandatory dust-settling derating margin of 250 t/h.
ENVC-AIRQ-VXS：For Pacific Northwest Agri-Logistics Consortium, an automated dust suppression system is installed across conveyor transfer galleries and shiploader chute heads, with a peak dust particulate emission concentration of 10 mg/m3 recorded at fence-line and conveyor discharge vents, and a mandatory dust-settling derating margin of 250 t/h.

information_points.title: Stormwater runoff management（WATER）
information_points.content:
ENVC-WATER-KUV：Cascade Bulk Marine Partners provides a retention basin retention volume of 7500 m3 across wharf and storage pad stormwater catchment settling basins.
ENVC-WATER-92X：Columbia River Grain Handling Alliance provides a retention basin retention volume of 4500 m3 across wharf and storage pad stormwater catchment settling basins.
ENVC-WATER-VRQ：Pacific Northwest Agri-Logistics Consortium provides a retention basin retention volume of 6000 m3 across wharf and storage pad stormwater catchment settling basins.
